title: Morse (Ciphers)
description: A while ago i noticed a pack for a caesar cipher, i wanted more neat packs!
body:
## This pack is Morse!

For the first in my seiries of ciphers i give you one of the more _well known_ cyphers.

This covers every string in the game exept the credit files. i want to do those as well but it will take a bit longer.
